articles.excerpt:

articles.title: Global Market: Euro hits 17-month low as French fiscal worries boost dollar
articles.excerpt:

The dollar strengthened despite weak US jobs data, supported by elevated Treasury yields and safe-haven demand. Diverging central-bank expectations and persistent bond volatility are likely to keep currency markets under pressure.
